amendments.review_rationale: Read numerical Kronecker delta for arbitrary set Gamma as a map on ordered pairs returning one for equality and zero otherwise.
amendments.reason: Reviewed the complete formulation and preserved all other previously assessed dependencies. Corrected unital-ring structure vs homomorphism distinction; retained source conventions and separated reusable prerequisites from defining conditions.

references.disposition: This 0/1 equality test is exactly the numerical Kronecker delta map being defined, so linking it to itself would be a circular definition. Equality of two arbitrary set elements is foundational.
The two specified integer outputs form the explicitly stated codomain of this definition; no new mathematical structure or distinct independently named prerequisite is assumed.
This is numerical equality on ordered pairs, not a measure or distribution.
